test_title: RRB Technician Grade III 2025 (Exam Day Practice): Mathematics
subject: maths
question: The price of an item increases by 20% every year, with the difference between its prices at the end of the third year and the fourth year being ₹180, what was its price at the end of the first year?
solution:
**Given:**

Annual increase = 20%

Difference between price at end of 4th year and 3rd year = 180

**Formula Used:**

Price after n years = Initial price × (1.20)ⁿ

Difference = Price₄ − Price₃

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let price at end of 1st year = P

⇒ Price at end of 3rd year = P × (1.20)²

⇒ Price at end of 4th year = P × (1.20)³

⇒ Difference = P × (1.20)³ − P × (1.20)²

⇒ Difference = P × (1.20)²(1.20 − 1)

⇒ Difference = P × (1.44)(0.20)

⇒ Difference = 0.288P

⇒ 0.288P = 180

⇒ P = 180 ÷ 0.288

⇒ P = 625

**∴ The correct answer is 625.**
